title: Launch HN: Alter (YC S25) – Access control for multi-user agents
title_zh: 发布 HN：Alter（YC S25）——多用户智能体的访问控制

paragraphs.en: Control what agents can do on behalf of each user. Enforce policy, keep credentials private, and audit every action.
paragraphs.zh: 控制智能体可以代表每位用户执行的操作。 强制执行策略，保护凭据私密，并审计每一项操作。

sents.en: Control what agents can do on behalf of each user.
sents.zh: 控制智能体可以代表每位用户执行的操作。

sents.en: Enforce policy, keep credentials private, and audit every action.
sents.zh: 强制执行策略，保护凭据私密，并审计每一项操作。

paragraphs.en: Pasted into prompts, configs, and .env files across every repo.
paragraphs.zh: 粘贴到每个仓库的提示词、配置文件和 .env 文件中。

paragraphs.en: Every agent borrows the same over-scoped credential.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都借用同一份权限过大的凭据。

paragraphs.en: Nobody can say which agent did what, or on whose behalf.
paragraphs.zh: 没有人能说清是哪个智能体做了什么，或代表谁行事。

paragraphs.en: Stored once and injected per request, so proxied calls keep it out of your code.
paragraphs.zh: 存储一次，每次请求时注入，因此通过代理的调用可将其排除在你的代码之外。

paragraphs.en: Each agent gets its own identity and scopes, with a human gate where you want one.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都拥有自己的身份和权限范围，并在需要处设置人工审核关卡。

paragraphs.en: A tamper-evident trail with a name attached to every call.
paragraphs.zh: 一条带有防篡改痕迹的记录，每次调用都附有名称。

paragraphs.en: One SDK call handles storage, refresh, policy, and audit for 140 providers. First-class LangChain, MCP, and AWS integrations.
paragraphs.zh: 一次 SDK 调用即可处理 140 个提供商的存储、刷新、策略和审计。 提供一流的 LangChain、MCP 和 AWS 集成。

sents.en: One SDK call handles storage, refresh, policy, and audit for 140 providers.
sents.zh: 一次 SDK 调用即可处理 140 个提供商的存储、刷新、策略和审计。

sents.en: First-class LangChain, MCP, and AWS integrations.
sents.zh: 提供一流的 LangChain、MCP 和 AWS 集成。

paragraphs.en: Store credentials once. Agents use them without ever seeing them.
paragraphs.zh: 凭证只需存储一次。 智能体使用它们，却永远看不到它们。

sents.en: Agents use them without ever seeing them.
sents.zh: 智能体使用它们，却永远看不到它们。

paragraphs.en: Each request checked against your rules. Deny by default.
paragraphs.zh: 每个请求都会根据你的规则进行检查。默认拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Per-agent keys and scopes, traceable to a real person.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体的密钥和权限范围，均可追溯至真实个人。

paragraphs.en: Sensitive calls wait for a named person. Everything else flows.
paragraphs.zh: 敏感的呼叫等待指定人员接听，其余的则顺畅流转。

paragraphs.en: A record you can hand to an auditor, streamed to your SIEM.
paragraphs.zh: 您可以交付给审计员的记录，可流式传输至您的 SIEM。

paragraphs.en: The full request path, end to end, on one page.
paragraphs.zh: 完整请求路径的端到端展示，尽在一页之中。

paragraphs.en: Every card is a working guide with code.
paragraphs.zh: 每张卡片都是一个包含代码的实用指南。

paragraphs.en: Run OAuth, Connect, and identity-aware token retrieval end to end.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端运行 OAuth、Connect 以及具备身份感知的令牌获取。

paragraphs.en: The agent gets its own identity, its user grants, and its own audit trail.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体拥有自己的身份、其用户的授权，以及自己的审计记录。

paragraphs.en: Store API keys and service tokens in Alter instead of environment variables.
paragraphs.zh: 将 API 密钥和服务令牌存储在 Alter 中，而不是环境变量。

paragraphs.en: Build your own MCP server that serves Alter-managed credentials as tools.
paragraphs.zh: 构建你自己的 MCP 服务器，将 Alter 管理的凭据作为工具来提供。

paragraphs.en: Key memory, sessions, and channels by verified identity, never by what the LLM claims.
paragraphs.zh: 按经验证的身份来管理关键记忆、会话和频道，绝不依据大语言模型（LLM）的声明。

paragraphs.en: Serve many users from one service without the credential entering your process.
paragraphs.zh: 从一个服务为多个用户提供服务，而凭据不会进入你的进程。

paragraphs.en: Our trust center publishes the live state of our security program: monitored controls, an independent penetration test within the last 12 months, and security policy documents on request.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的信任中心公布我们安全计划的实时状态：受监控的控制措施、过去12个月内的独立渗透测试，以及应请求提供的安全策略文档。

paragraphs.en: Book a 30-minute walkthrough with the founders.
paragraphs.zh: 与创始人预约一次30分钟的产品演示。

paragraphs.en: Privileged access for AI agents. Credentials, policy, approvals, and audit for every call an agent makes through Alter.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体的特权访问。 智能体通过 Alter 进行的每一次调用的凭证、策略、审批和审计。

sents.zh: AI 智能体的特权访问。

sents.en: Credentials, policy, approvals, and audit for every call an agent makes through Alter.
sents.zh: 智能体通过 Alter 进行的每一次调用的凭证、策略、审批和审计。

paragraphs.zh: © 2026 Alter Labs, Inc. 版权所有。

paragraphs.en: We use optional analytics to improve Alter and privacy-masked diagnostics to understand and fix problems. Cookie Notice
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用可选的分析工具来改进 Alter，并使用隐私脱敏的诊断数据来了解和修复问题。Cookie 通知

paragraphs.en: Choose which optional technologies Alter can use. Necessary technologies are always active. Read our Cookie Notice .
paragraphs.zh: 选择允许 Alter 使用哪些可选技术。 必要技术始终处于启用状态。请阅读我们的 Cookie 通知。

sents.en: Choose which optional technologies Alter can use.
sents.zh: 选择允许 Alter 使用哪些可选技术。

sents.en: Necessary technologies are always active. Read our Cookie Notice .
sents.zh: 必要技术始终处于启用状态。请阅读我们的 Cookie 通知。

paragraphs.en: Required for sign-in, security, authorization, and remembering your choices.
paragraphs.zh: 登录、安全、授权以及记住您的选择时需要用到。

paragraphs.en: Helps us understand which product and documentation features are useful.
paragraphs.zh: 帮助我们了解哪些产品和文档功能是有用的。

paragraphs.en: Uses performance tracing and privacy-masked session replay to diagnose problems.
paragraphs.zh: 使用性能追踪和隐私脱敏的会话回放来诊断问题。

paragraphs.en: You can change these choices at any time from Cookie settings.
paragraphs.zh: 您随时可以在 Cookie 设置中更改这些选择。
